caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, tapering container with outward-sloping sides and four small, curved feet, rendered in shades of reddish-brown to suggest a wood or similar material. The main illustration is centered and occupies the majority of the space, showing a three-quarter perspective of the container. The container features a slightly flared rim at the top and a narrower base, with visible wood grain texture. Surrounding the central image are three technical sketches in pencil, positioned in the upper left, upper right, and lower center of the page. The upper left and right sketches show side views of the container with proportional measurements (labeled numerically), while the lower center sketch shows a top view divided into four rectangles, also with numerical dimensions indicated. The background is a plain beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Wine Cooler
